Valet Parking & High-Speed EV Supercharging Surcharge

reasoning: Two-night Berlin stay for investor meetings; the nights of October 14 and 15, 2024 begin on a Monday and a Tuesday, so no night falls on a weekend or public holiday and the weekend flowchart does not apply. The note names investor meetings rather than a declared trade-fair or congress event from the Chapter 9 table, so no event surcharge cap applies and Berlin's ordinary €160 Tier 2 cap governs; the 'Atelier Suite' category earns no higher cap, so each €230 night is reimbursed at €160 with €70 deducted per night. The note states that a garment was soiled by a spill during lunch, so the €28 emergency dry cleaning qualifies for the €25 short-stay garment-rescue cap and €3.00 is deducted. Both minibar lines are deducted in full, since minibar snacks and beverages are excluded whatever they cost. The note identifies the rental EV, so the €70 two-night valet parking with EV supercharging surcharge is reimbursed up to €30 per night, i.e. €60, with €10 deducted. City tax is reimbursed in full. VAT is allocated line by line at each line's printed rate on its deducted portion (7% on the room-rate excess, 19% on the other deductions), which deducts €18.07 of the €56.88 VAT.
